'''Gudren Lagarian''' was a pilgrim of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]]. He was part of the group led by [[Honarius Hanast]] who hired a group of [[free-trader]]s to transport them to [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]. During the trip, Lagarian went missing. His body was found crammed into a maintenance shaft.
